title: Can AI Help Explain AI? Effects of Multimodal LLM-Generated Explanations on Perceived Understanding and Perceived Trust in XAI Visualizations
abstract: arXiv:2611.21638v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) aims to make machine learning models understandable, yet many XAI visualizations remain difficult for end-users to interpret. Here, we evaluate whether augmenting XAI outputs with textual explanations from multimodal LLMs improves perceived understanding and perceived trust. We conducted a pre-registered within-subject experiment ($N = 128$) across seven decision scenarios and five XAI methods, with and without LLM generated explanations. The explanations improved perceived understanding and perceived trust by 0.35 and 0.26 points on five-point scales (both $p < .001$). The gain appeared in all seven scenarios, did not differ between local and global explanations, and was largest for participants with the least prior XAI exposure. translated_title: AI能否帮助解释AI？多模态大语言模型生成的解释对XAI可视化中感知理解与感知信任的影响
translated_abstract: 可解释人工智能（XAI）旨在让机器学习模型变得可理解，然而许多XAI可视化对最终用户来说仍然难以解读。本研究评估了在XAI输出基础上附加多模态大语言模型（LLM）生成的文本解释，是否能提升用户的感知理解与感知信任。我们开展了一项预注册的被试内实验（N = 128），涵盖七个决策场景和五种XAI方法，分别在有和无LLM生成解释的条件下进行测试。结果显示，这些解释使感知理解和感知信任在五点量表上分别提高了0.35分和0.26分（均p < .001）。这一提升出现在全部七个场景中，且在局部解释与全局解释之间没有差异，而对先前XAI接触最少的参与者提升最为显著。中介分析表明，LLM解释通过感知理解对感知信任产生间接影响。这些结果表明，多模态大语言模型可以提供有用的解释。
tldr: 本研究通过128人的预注册实验证明，为XAI可视化附加多模态大语言模型生成的文本解释能显著提升用户的感知理解与感知信任，且对缺乏XAI经验的新手效果最为显著。
en_tdlr: Multimodal LLM-generated textual explanations significantly enhance perceived understanding and perceived trust in XAI visualizations across diverse decision scenarios, with the largest gains among users with the least prior XAI experience.
